It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 28, 2020}} The district consists of the city of [[Dagupan]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Manaoag]], [[Mangaldan]], [[San Fabian, Pangasinan|San Fabian]] and [[San Jacinto, Pangasinan|San Jacinto]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Gina de Venecia]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]] (Lakas).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 28, 2020}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, the district consisted of the central Pangasinan municipalities of [[Alcala, Pangasinan|Alcala]], [[Bautista, Pangasinan|Bautista]], [[Binalonan]], [[Manaoag]], [[Pozorrubio]], [[Santo Tomas, Pangasinan|Santo Tomas]], [[Sison, Pangasinan|Sison]], [[Urdaneta, Pangasinan|Urdaneta]], and [[Villasis]].
